items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I would like to say Sam Morgan and the other Sam used to come over, and I'd make it my business to go up on the bandstand and watch the piano that's most of them

ctx.x: Yeah. When Tymy came in the band, when Desden was making up the band, we- Pierron No. 2. Yeah. We had, that's when the oil force said, Felice Goff, Shine, Ram and Brown Trombone, Old Man Kimball Bass. What's Shine?
Is that Shine played with Sam? Nolan Williams. Nolan Williams. Yeah, Shine. Made the record with Sam Wilson.
That's right. That's right. And, uh... And, and Goff played what? Felice Goff played plenty of clarinet. Clarinet and tenor sax. And, uh, Fauche?
